built_from: glyph layers of the 886 pages of the F8g2 Reshumot capture (84 booklets, 2006-2026)
method: Outline = first 16 hex digits of the SHA-256 of the glyph's TrueType glyf bytes (hocrgen.parsers.pdf_glyphs). An outline read as one character by every font's ToUnicode map takes it; conflicting readings are settled only by a recorded check of the rendered glyphs. A bracket outline records its drawn shape: its character is the shape in a left-to-right run and the mirror image in a right-to-left run (UBA L4), whatever ToUnicode says, because the subsets disagree on which of the pair they name.

check.method: rendered instances of the outline cropped from 150 dpi page renders (pdftoppm) and compared by eye, including instances whose ToUnicode reading is the minority one (contact sheet f8e2/probe/outline_sheet_*.png)
